entries.title: Ezekiel 28:1
segments: ¶The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:2
segments: "Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Because your heart [is] lifted up, And you say, 'I [am] a god, I sit [in] the seat of gods, In the midst of the seas,' Yet you [are] a man, and not a god, Though you set your heart as the heart of a god

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:3
segments: (Behold, you [are] wiser than Daniel! There is no secret that can be hidden from you!

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:4
segments: With your wisdom and your understanding You have gained riches for yourself, And gathered gold and silver into your treasuries;

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:5
segments: By your great wisdom in trade you have increased your riches, And your heart is lifted up because of your riches),"

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:6
segments: 'Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: "Because you have set your heart as the heart of a god,

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:7
segments: Behold, therefore, I will bring strangers against you, The most terrible of the nations; And they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, And defile your splendor.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:8
segments: They shall throw you down into the Pit, And you shall die the death of the slain In the midst of the seas.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:9
segments: "Will you still say before him who slays you, 'I [am] a god'? But you [shall be] a man, and not a god, In the hand of him who slays you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:10
segments: You shall die the death of the uncircumcised By the hand of aliens; For I have spoken," says the Lord GOD.'"

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:11
segments: ¶Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:12
segments: "Son of man, take up a lamentation for the king of Tyre, and say to him, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "You [were] the seal of perfection, Full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:13
segments: You were in Eden, the garden of God; Every precious stone [was] your covering: The sardius, topaz, and diamond, Beryl, onyx, and jasper, Sapphire, turquoise, and emerald with gold. The workmanship of your timbrels and pipes Was prepared for you on the day you were created.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:14
segments: "You [were] the anointed cherub who covers; I established you; You were on the holy mountain of God; You walked back and forth in the midst of fiery stones.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:15
segments: You [were] perfect in your ways from the day you were created, Till iniquity was found in you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:16
segments: "By the abundance of your trading You became filled with violence within, And you sinned; Therefore I cast you as a profane thing Out of the mountain of God; And I destroyed you, O covering cherub, From the midst of the fiery stones.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:17
segments: "Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; You corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendor; I cast you to the ground, I laid you before kings, That they might gaze at you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:18
segments: "You defiled your sanctuaries By the multitude of your iniquities, By the iniquity of your trading; Therefore I brought fire from your midst; It devoured you, And I turned you to ashes upon the earth In the sight of all who saw you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:19
segments: All who knew you among the peoples are astonished at you; You have become a horror, And [shall be] no more forever."'"

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:20
segments: ¶Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:21
segments: "Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against her,

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:22
segments: "and say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Behold, I [am] against you, O Sidon; I will be glorified in your midst; And they shall know that I [am] the LORD, When I execute judgments in her and am hallowed in her.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:23
segments: For I will send pestilence upon her, And blood in her streets; The wounded shall be judged in her midst By the sword against her on every side; Then they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:24
segments: "And there shall no longer be a pricking brier or a painful thorn for the house of Israel from among all [who are] around them, who despise them. Then they shall know that I [am] the Lord GOD."

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:25
segments: 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am hallowed in them in the sight of the Gentiles, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to My servant Jacob.

entries.title: Ezekiel 28:26
segments: "And they will dwell safely there, build houses, and plant vineyards; yes, they will dwell securely, when I execute judgments on all those around them who despise them. Then they shall know that I [am] the LORD their God."'"
